adds.title: Luke Cage S2#2
adds.text: Claire stops by the barbershop, and Bobby tells her about the daughter he left behind and says he is there to look out for Luke.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Luke's girlfriend. Hears him out about his daughter.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Luke's friend at Pop's. Opens up to her about his daughter.
adds.evidence: Straighten It Out: Fish stays at the barbershop and is met by Claire Temple; they talk about his daughter ('Luke might be bulletproof... I'm here to protect him.' 'You're a good man, Bobby.').

adds.title: Luke Cage S2#3
adds.text: Claire treats Cockroach after Luke nearly beats him to death and calls Misty to the scene, and Misty gets Luke away before other detectives arrive.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Comes when she calls about Cockroach's beating.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Calls her to Cockroach's apartment after Luke's beating.
adds.evidence: Wig Out: Temple treats Cockroach Hamilton's injuries; she later says she only called for Knight and an ambulance; Knight lets Cage leave before Tyler and Bailey arrive.

adds.title: Luke Cage S2#1
adds.text: Comanche draws his gun on Luke when he storms into Mariah's office at Harlem's Paradise, then watches him warn her to leave Claire out of it.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Storms into Mariah's office while he stands guard.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Mariah's man. Pulls a gun on him in her office.
adds.evidence: Soul Brother #1: Comanche draws his gun at Cage when Cage bursts into Dillard's office with the Judas bullet and warns her about Claire Temple.

adds.title: Luke Cage S2#10
adds.text: Luke and Danny eat at Connie's new restaurant, and Luke turns down her offer of another place to rent so he won't put her at risk again.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Her old tenant. Won't rent from her again for her sake.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: His old landlady. Offers him another place to rent.
adds.evidence: The Main Ingredient: Cage and Rand eat at Genghis Connie's Too; Connie offers more places to rent, Cage says he can't take the risk of it being blown up.

adds.title: Luke Cage S2#11
adds.text: On a Stokes family trip to Jamaica years ago, the young Cornell splashes Mariah in the pool and tells her to get in while she tries to read.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: His cousin. Reads by the pool in Jamaica as a girl.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Her cousin. Splashes her in the pool as a boy.
adds.evidence: The Creator: 1980s flashback of the Stokes family in Jamaica; young Cornell splashes Mariah in the pool while she reads.

adds.title: Luke Cage S2#4
adds.text: Danny and Colleen send Misty a personal letter with the blueprints for a robotic arm from Rand Enterprises, and she decides to try it.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Accepts the robotic arm he and Colleen send her.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Sends her a robotic arm with Colleen.
adds.evidence: I Get Physical: at the precinct Knight receives a letter from Danny Rand and Colleen Wing with blueprints for a prosthetic arm and decides to try it out (Danny is not on screen; he appears later in The Main Ingredient).

adds.title: Luke Cage S2#5
adds.text: Foggy represents Luke in Cockroach's lawsuit, tells him to settle out of court, and finds him the paid appearance at Piranha's party to cover it.
adds.evidence: All Souled Out: with Foggy Nelson as his lawyer, Cage meets Hamilton and Donovan; Nelson says to avoid court, offers him a paid appearance, and goes with him to Piranha Jones.

adds.title: Luke Cage S2#13
adds.text: With Mariah in jail, Shades walks into the barbershop to warn Luke that other gangs are moving on Harlem and urges him to take over himself.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Mariah's old enforcer. Urges him to take over Harlem.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Hears his warning about Harlem but doesn't trust him.
adds.evidence: They Reminisce Over You: Shades walks into Pop's Barber Shop and tells Cage the Carbones and the Puerto Rican mob plan to take Harlem and that he wants Cage to take over; Cage does not believe him.

adds.title: Luke Cage S2#10
adds.text: Luke and Danny track down Turk, who gives up the Jamaicans' grow house to be rid of them, and Luke tells him to send a bill for the bong he broke.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Gives up the Jamaicans' grow house to get rid of him.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Breaks his bong and tells him to send a bill.
adds.evidence: The Main Ingredient: Cage and Rand search out Turk Barrett, who gives them the Grow House address to get rid of them and demands Cage pay for the broken bong.

adds.title: Luke Cage S2#5
adds.text: Misty remembers arresting Cockroach with Scarfe years earlier, when Scarfe secretly planted the gun that put him away.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Her late partner. Planted the gun in their old Cockroach case.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: His old partner. Arrests Cockroach with him.
adds.evidence: All Souled Out: real flashbacks of Scarfe and Knight arresting Hamilton, Scarfe having placed the gun without telling her; Knight then questions Ridenhour about whether Scarfe faked evidence.

owner_calls.title: Luke Cage S2
owner_calls.question: In Luke Cage S2#10 Danny comes to Harlem because Claire asked him (off screen, only mentioned). Add a stage for that, or leave none?
options: add friend, Luke Cage S2#10: Danny comes to Harlem to help Luke at Claire's request
owner_calls.evidence: Claire Temple page: 'Temple asked Danny Rand to help him with his war against Bushmaster' (LC210, mentioned).

owner_calls.title: Luke Cage S2
owner_calls.question: Proposed kind for the Luke Cage S2#13 stage is rival (Shades has turned on Mariah and advises Luke). Keep enemy instead to match the earlier stages?
owner_calls.evidence: They Reminisce Over You: Shades urges Cage to take over Harlem; Cage does not believe him.
